name: CacheTileMappingJob
description: job of pool "KTGLGraph.Cache.UpdateTileMapping" (32 threads): unless c+CC8h (GFX drain active) loops {SRW c+CC0h; CacheTileRingProcessCopyQueue(c+6A8h ring, c+608h pages, c+A8h tile batch, c+8F0h stats)} while ring head != tail; registered by KtglCacheInit 2EF053C

name: CacheTileRingProcessCopyQueue
signature: void (Ring* r, PageTable* pt, TileBatch* b, Stats* s)
description: drains the cache request ring (0x28-byte entries): state 1 map -> batch (flush on resource/heap change or full), 2 unmap (NULL) -> batch, 3 -> b->queue->Wait(fence,value) (vtbl+78h); flushes via 290F94 into the cache COPY queue; ends with queue->Signal(b+50h fence, ++b+58h) (vtbl+70h); in-flight batches throttled by the ring at b+468h..488h (cap b+470h)

name: CacheTileBatchFlushDirect
signature: void (TileBatch* b, ID3D12CommandQueue* q, Stats* s)
description: q->UpdateTileMappings(b+10h res, n=b+4, b+18h coords, b+20h sizes, b+8 heap, n, b+30h flags, b+28h starts, b+38h counts, 0) (vtbl+40h, site 290FFB); s+3Ch += n; clears the batch. The only direct UTM call site in engine code

name: CacheTileBatchAddMap
signature: void (TileBatch* b, ID3D12Heap* h, u32 page, ID3D12Resource* r, Coord* c)
description: append one single-tile region {1,TRUE,1,1,1}, range NONE start=page count 1

name: CacheTileBatchMapNeedsFlush
signature: bool (TileBatch* b, ID3D12Heap* h, ID3D12Resource* r)
description: true unless (b heap 0 or h) and (b res 0 or r) and count < capacity

name: CacheTileBatchAddUnmap
signature: void (TileBatch* b, ID3D12Resource* r, Coord* c)
description: append one single-tile region, range NULL count 1, heap cleared

name: CacheTileBatchUnmapNeedsFlush
description: true unless b heap == 0 and (res 0 or r) and count < capacity (map and unmap never share a call)

name: CacheTileBatchFlushRecorded
signature: void (TileBatch* b, Ctx* ctx, Stats* s)
description: records the batch as ECL token 4 into ctx+5A0h (189BF3C -> 2F150AC) instead of calling D3D12; s+3Ch += n

name: CtxEmitUpdateTileMappings
description: stream = rcx+40h; -> EclEmitUpdateTileMappings 2F150AC

name: CtxEmitCopyTileMappings
description: stream = rcx+40h; -> EclEmitCopyTileMappings 2F15010

name: EclEmitUpdateTileMappings
description: writes ECL token 4 {resource, n regions, coords[], sizes[], heap, n ranges, flags[], starts[], counts[]} (site 2F150D8)

name: EclEmitCopyTileMappings
description: writes ECL token 5 (site 2F15021)

name: EclTokUpdateTileMappings
description: ECL token 4 handler: e->vtbl+50h (= GfxExecUpdateTileMappings 2F0103C) with the 9 decoded arguments

name: EclTokCopyTileMappings
description: ECL token 5 handler: e->vtbl+58h (= GfxExecCopyTileMappings 2EFC060)

name: GfxExecUpdateTileMappings
description: [[this+8]+4270h] (the GFX DIRECT queue) ->UpdateTileMappings (vtbl+40h, site 2F0109D, Flags 0); slot +50h of the ECL executor vtable 409A620

name: GfxExecCopyTileMappings
description: GFX queue [dev+4270h]->CopyTileMappings (vtbl+48h, site 2EFC08B); executor vtable slot +58h

name: GfxQueueExecutorVtbl
description: ECL replay target used by the token handlers: +30h 4F90DC, +38h 2F01150, +40h 4F92A4, +48h 4F9194, +50h 2F0103C UTM, +58h 2EFC060 CTM, +60h 2EFB19C

name: CtxUpdateTileMappings
description: recording context: stream ctx+5A0h -> 189BF3C (token 4)

name: KtglCacheInit
signature: bool (KtglCache* c, GfxDevice* d, CacheDesc* desc, ...)
description: creates the KTGLGraph resource cache ([45BA588]+61A0h): +A8h tile batch + own COPY queue (2F110A8), +538h GFX-recorded tile batch (2F111AC), +590h, +608h page table, +678h, +6A8h request ring, 4 job pools (+6F8h CacheTileMappingJob 126630, +728h, +758h, +788h), +868h upload COPY queue + N copy contexts (2F13350), +8F0h stats

name: CacheTileQueueCreate
description: CreateCommandQueue(COPY) into b+40h (falls back to the GFX queue d+4270h on failure), event b+48h, fence b+50h, value b+58h, in-flight ring b+460h

name: CacheGfxTileBatchInit
description: batch for the GFX-recorded path: event +40h, fence +48h (device d+4268h)

name: CacheUploadQueueCreate
description: CreateCommandQueue(COPY) + N {allocator, list, ...} upload contexts (texture tile data)

name: CacheFlushOnGfx
description: render-thread drain of the cache request ring onto the GFX context (d+10h) under the job's lock: map/unmap -> CacheTileBatch (c+538h) -> ECL token 4, then CacheTileBatchFlushAndSignalGfx (token 7 Signal on the GFX queue + SetEventOnCompletion). Called twice per frame by RenderFrameBeginCacheFlush, and at reset

name: RenderFrameBeginCacheFlush
description: from RenderFrameBegin 4A529C: CacheFlushOnGfx, 32FED04, CacheFlushOnGfx again, 32F3970

name: CacheRingDrainToCtx
description: ring state 2 -> CacheTileBatchUnmap 2F11318, state 1 -> 2F0F9AC page map -> CachePageMapTile 2F118F8 -> CacheTileBatchMap 2F10FF4

name: CacheTileBatchFlushAndSignalGfx
signature: void (TileBatch* b, Ctx* ctx, Stats* s)
description: ++b+50h; CacheTileBatchFlushRecorded; CtxEmitSignalGfx(ctx, b+48h fence, value); fence->SetEventOnCompletion(value, b+40h event). Runs on every CacheFlushOnGfx, also when no tile changed

name: CtxEmitSignalGfx
signature: void (Ctx* ctx, ID3D12Fence** f, u64 v)
description: ctx+5A0h stream, queue = [45BA588]+4270h -> 48FF10 (ECL Signal token)

name: CacheTileBatchUnmap
description: flush if CacheTileBatchUnmapNeedsFlush, then CacheTileBatchAddUnmap

name: CacheTileBatchMap
description: flush if CacheTileBatchMapNeedsFlush, then CacheTileBatchAddMap

name: CachePageMapTile
description: page index -> pool heap (+10h) + heap page, -> CacheTileBatchMap

name: CacheTileBatchFlushThenCopy
description: CacheTileBatchFlushRecorded then 2F10F68 -> CtxEmitCopyTileMappings (the only CopyTileMappings user)

name: CacheUnmapOnCtx
description: token-driven unmap (2F0D774 handler): first use inits the context, then 2EEF5AC -> CacheTileBatchUnmap on the cache GFX batch

name: KtglCacheShutdown
description: teardown: CacheFlushOnGfx, release queues/jobs, CacheTileBatchFlushAndSignalGfx

name: PagePoolFrameUpdate
description: also: snapshots the cache stats block c+8F8h -> c+A10h each frame and zeroes it (+3Ch of the block = tiles updated)

name: CreateReservedResource_Backend
description: device->CreateReservedResource in the generic backend texture creator (signature-checked candidate; 62A191, 62D679 are the other two candidates)
